nodes.label: Accepted PT/EN Naming Inconsistencies
nodes.rationale: Names like user.nome, percentConclued, lstAlternative, conclued come from the backend; refactoring them in the front alone would break the contract.

nodes.label: Golden Rule: Copy the Neighbor File Pattern
nodes.norm_label: golden rule: copy the neighbor file pattern
nodes.rationale: TCC project touched by 6 people of varying skill; consistency is valued over sophistication, so no new libraries, state patterns or abstractions without explicit request.

nodes.label: Hooks Return null Instead of Throwing
nodes.norm_label: hooks return null instead of throwing
nodes.rationale: Errors never bubble to screens as exceptions; screens just check if (!response), keeping them free of try/catch.

nodes.label: SecureStore Instead of AsyncStorage
nodes.rationale: Token persistence goes through expo-secure-store via storageService; AsyncStorage is not used.

nodes.label: AuthContext as Only Global State
nodes.rationale: User must be shared across screens; all auth functions follow the same setLoading/try/catch/finally template and return null on error.

nodes.label: Session Restore on Boot (initializing flag)
nodes.rationale: Provider renders LoadingPage and does not mount navigation until token+me() check finishes, avoiding a login-screen flash.

nodes.label: Layer Rule: Screen -> Hook -> Service -> api
nodes.norm_label: layer rule: screen -> hook -> service -> api
nodes.rationale: Screens never import api or services; services have no try/catch or state; hooks own loading/error; components never call the API. AuthContext is the deliberate exception as a global hook shared across screens.

nodes.label: Drag and Drop Pattern (gesture-handler + reanimated)
nodes.rationale: Shared values instead of state avoid re-render every frame; measure() after setTimeout 100ms waits for native layout; shared values must be reset manually between questions.

nodes.rationale: Routing by question.type is the right path once 3+ types exist, but is a team decision.
